extracted.name: Tequila Sunrise
extracted.description: Recipe video above. Simple recipe but useful to see the best way to get the red "sunrise" effect on the bottom of the glass! Use recipe SCALER to scale recipe up.
instruction_lines: Pour tequila and orange juice in a tall glass. Scale up recipe as required for your glass side (1 part tequila to 3 parts OJ)!
Drizzle grenadine down the side of the glass over the back of a teaspoon (see video). Do not mix!
Garnish with orange slice and Maraschino cherry. Serve immediately!
